from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CourtDocument(BaseModel):
    """Represents one court document from the collection."""
    title: str = Field(description="The title of the court document, used for the final answer")
    case_type: str | None = Field(description="The broad legal case category (e.g., Administrative, Civil, Criminal)")
    cause_of_action: str | None = Field(description="The specific cause of action or case label identified in the document")
    administrative_behavior_category: str | None = Field(description="The specific type of administrative act if the case is administrative (e.g., '行政处罚', '行政强制', '行政登记')")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    documents: list[CourtDocument] = Field(description="Aggregated list of all parsed court documents")
